name: pipedeck
description: Voicemeeter-style audio routing hub for PipeWire — combined outputs, virtual mics, per-app routing, web GUI

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
